recentItems.description:
Zeruel's debut album 'Ruin;Rebirth' is out now—buy/stream at https://zeruel.lnk.to/RuinRebirth.

Lyrics:
Devoid of purpose I fall below
This chasm, my furnace, I seek to free
These shackles that bind my soul
Grow wings and return home
The light now beckons
For me to end this reckoning
It is relieving that Arcadia still welcomes me back
Even after my fall
I will rid the world of all chaos
And grace shall not whither again
For I am a vessel of light
Desolate
A world so flagrant
Bloodstained air
Could life be vacant
Convergence of our firmament
And resurgence befalls
Grace not yet gone
Mercy still calls
Desire to soar
But cursed to fall
I’ll face the light
And heed thy word
To cleanse this world once more
Wouldst thou welcome me back home again
Wouldst thou welcome me back home again
Wouldst thou welcome me back home again
Wouldst thou welcome me back home again
